correctness.rationale: For two same-side vertices, an avoiding geodesic exists exactly when the opposite-side complement contains an index outside the two endpoints, which for all pairs is equivalent to complement size at least three. Under the two side conditions every matched nonedge has a length-three geodesic with both internal vertices outside the selected set. The checker exhaustively validates all subsets for n=3 through 8.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural and enumerative result for a standard dense bipartite family. It determines every feasible set, the full polynomial, the maximum, and all maximal sets, and it exposes a sharp change relative to K_{n,n} caused by deleting a perfect matching.
